nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Fotovoltaico Double-Ring Design
nodes.rationale: The old ring compared productionToday against gridToday directly, two numbers never meant to sum to anything, so the shown percentage didn't correspond to a real quantity. The new design uses two concentric rings that each genuinely sum to 100% of themselves: outer = consumption (autoconsumo + prelievo), inner = production (autoconsumo + immissione), sharing the autoconsumo segment as the number common to both. With no export sensor, it falls back to the old single-ring view instead of showing a wrong or empty double ring.

nodes.label: panel_custom name/<folder>-panel Derivation
nodes.rationale: The panel custom element registers itself under <folder>-panel, derived from the deploy folder panel.js runs from, so configuration.yaml's panel_custom.name: must exactly match that folder. A mismatch loads a blank/black panel; since v1.4.0 a self-check names the expected/actual folder in a console.error and on-page message instead of failing silently.

nodes.label: module_url ?v= Cache-Bust Requirement
nodes.rationale: /local/ is served with long cache headers and browsers cache ES modules aggressively, so a plain hard refresh doesn't reliably force a re-fetch of panel.js after an update; the ?v= query param on module_url must be bumped on every update to force the browser to re-fetch.

nodes.label: CONFIG_PATHS Fallback-Order Design
nodes.rationale: CONFIG_PATHS is tried in order, first hit wins: /local/live_dashboard_config.js (outside any HACS-managed folder, survives updates), then /local/community/live_dashboard/config.js (back-compat for an earlier HACS layout), then ./config.js (manual installs). The two /local/ candidates are skipped entirely when opened outside HA (file://, ?demo) since they can never resolve there and would only log a network 404.

nodes.label: ASSET_VERSION Cache-Bust Chain Design
nodes.rationale: Classic <script> tag injection is used instead of dynamic import() because Chrome blocks ES module fetches from file:// origins entirely, which would break demo mode's file:// requirement; discovery.js/i18n.js/ha-backend-*.js/config.js are all loaded this way and expose window.Casa* globals. The page reuses the same ?v= query param panel.js used to load this file itself when bust()-ing every child <script src>, so one VERSION bump busts the whole loading chain, not just the page.
